params.prompt: Energetic electronic game trailer music. Driving four-on-the-floor beat around 128 BPM, punchy analog synth bass, bright arpeggiated plucks, crisp claps and hi-hats. Confident and hyped like a mobile battle game trailer, but clean and mid-scooped so a voiceover sits on top of it. Builds gradually, a short filtered breakdown in the middle, then a bigger final section. No vocals, no speech, instrumental only, seamless and steady throughout.
